summary_markdown:
Discussion centered on manually triggering a specific data import job for Ramboll data. [p1] needs to run the job immediately because Ramboll fixed an issue (missing one week of data) and wants to upload the data from their API directly into the database.
[p2] confirmed that running the job is acceptable, noting that the process should be straightforward. [p2] also suggested that if the API fails to return data by key, it can be done manually.
decisions: The data import job for Ramboll data can be run manually.
action_items: [p1] to run the data import job using the provided link/flow.
